data.body: **[P2] Reject unsupported payload-envelope versions.** A value beginning `@aws-durable-payload:v2:` does not match the exact v1 prefix and is therefore passed to user SerDes as a legacy payload. A pass-through/custom codec can silently consume unsupported protocol data, contrary to the documented fail-closed contract. Detect the reserved `@aws-durable-payload:` marker and throw for unsupported or malformed versions before invoking SerDes; add direct and framed-invoke v2 tests.
